name: alur-agent
description: Local-first Firefox automation assistant for the ALUR pseudocode lab

scripts.smoke:openrouter: bash -c 'if [ -z "$OPENROUTER_API_KEY" ]; then echo "UNVERIFIED: OPENROUTER_API_KEY not configured"; exit 0; fi; echo "LIVE SMOKE STARTED: calling OpenRouter /models with configured key"; RESP=$(curl -s -o /tmp/alur_smoke_resp.json -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_API_KEY" "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models" --max-time 15); echo "HTTP $RESP"; if [ "$RESP" = "200" ]; then MODEL_COUNT=$(node -e "try{const d=require("/tmp/alur_smoke_resp.json"); console.log(typeof d.data!=="undefined"?d.data.length:0)}catch{console.log(0)}"); if [ "$MODEL_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then echo "PASS: OpenRouter live smoke OK (models=$MODEL_COUNT, model=openrouter/free configured)"; else echo "FAIL: HTTP 200 but invalid response body"; exit 1; fi; else echo "FAIL: OpenRouter live smoke rejected (HTTP $RESP)"; exit 1; fi'
